observations: Both .output/chrome-mv3-dev/manifest.json and immutable CI chrome-mv3/manifest.json have version 0.2.579, name Matrx Extend DEV, action.default_title Matrx, and action.default_popup popup.html.
wxt.config.ts manifest callback chooses Matrx Extend DEV for keyed Chrome and returns action.default_title=extensionTitle; current source callback test only calls this function.
Installed WXT find-entrypoints.mjs reads popup HTML title then getPopupEntrypoint sets defaultTitle=title.

Installed WXT manifest.mjs calls addEntrypoints after defu(userManifest,baseManifest); it copies popup.options.defaultTitle into action.default_title, overwriting callback value. Then build:manifestGenerated hook runs.
src/lib/credentials/assistance-status.ts reads manifest.action.default_title before manifest.name for keyed development and uses it for action title state.
root_cause: WXT popup entrypoint title overrides callback action.default_title during manifest generation; callback-only tests miss generated artifact boundary.
smallest_fix: At existing build:manifestGenerated hook in wxt.config.ts, set manifest.action.default_title to Matrx Extend DEV for keyed Chrome development after WXT adds entrypoints. Keep Store handling unchanged.
forcing_guard: Extend built-manifest gate scripts/check-browser-manifests.mjs (or equivalent) to assert keyed Chrome artifact manifest.name and action.default_title equal Matrx Extend DEV; demonstrate red on current immutable CI artifact/current .output before fix, green on fresh WXT output after fix. Callback unit test alone cannot guard this boundary.
runtime_limit: chrome.action.setTitle can change displayed per-tab title, never manifest.json. Defect is present in immutable and local artifacts before runtime.
not_run: No build, browser, source edits, artifact edits, or tests per assignment.
